title: COREP C 01.00 – Own Funds (CA1)
source_basis: C 01.00 rows and labels sourced from supervisory reporting annexes, notably Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/3117. Always verify the applicable template for the target EBA module and reference date.
model_state: Actual DPM 2.0 database IDs, precise typed axes/ordinate identifiers, XBRL QNames, taxonomy entry points and official validation-rule IDs have not been imported.
scope: 15 selected official template rows for guided IFRS-to-prudential mapping; not a full EBA data point extraction or a filing engine.
row_codes_verified_against: Regulation (EU) 2024/3117 Annex I and related reporting instructions; version changes, EBA taxonomy releases and reported module dates must be separately checked.
release_reference: Regulation (EU) 2024/3117; technical taxonomy release must be selected after official package ingestion

rows.label: OWN FUNDS
rows.definition: Total eligible Tier 1 plus eligible Tier 2 own funds, after applicable prudential adjustments and deductions.
rows.link: Derived total of eligible prudential capital; not an IFRS balance-sheet caption or individual accounting entry.
rows.adjust: Reconcile CET1, AT1 and T2 across prudential consolidation and regulatory eligibility.
rows.check: Aggregate formula check against underlying components; not a published EBA VR identifier.
rows.coordinate_status: Template row verified; technical DPM cell metadata not imported

rows.label: TIER 1 CAPITAL
rows.definition: Sum of Common Equity Tier 1 and Additional Tier 1 capital after relevant adjustments.
rows.link: CET1 and AT1 eligibility must be analysed separately from instrument classification under IFRS.
rows.adjust: Capital adequacy aggregation; may include instruments that are IFRS liabilities if CRR AT1 conditions are met.
rows.check: Component reconciliation: CET1 + AT1, after relevant prudential treatments.
rows.coordinate_status: Template row verified; technical DPM cell metadata not imported

rows.label: COMMON EQUITY TIER 1 CAPITAL
rows.definition: Eligible CET1 items less mandatory adjustments and deductions according to the CRR.
rows.link: Accounting equity is the starting point, not CET1: deductions, prudential filters, profit eligibility and consolidation differences matter.
rows.adjust: Aggregate eligible CET1 after CRR Articles 32–49 and associated treatments.
rows.check: Prudential equity bridge from ledger/FINREP to eligible CET1.
rows.coordinate_status: Template row verified; technical DPM cell metadata not imported

rows.label: Capital instruments eligible as CET1 Capital
rows.definition: CET1-eligible capital instruments and closely related eligible items, less the template's specific deductions.
rows.link: Start from issued equity and related share premium; legal terms and CRR eligibility tests determine inclusion.
rows.adjust: Exclude non-eligible instruments; deduct own CET1 holdings and other relevant adjustments.
rows.check: Eligible instruments tie-out to approved register, equity ledger and own-holdings adjustments.
rows.coordinate_status: Template row verified; technical DPM cell metadata not imported

rows.label: Fully paid up capital instruments
rows.definition: Capital instruments fully paid up and meeting the CET1 conditions.
rows.link: Financial-statement equity share capital account plus issued-instrument register; may require exclusions under CRR.
rows.adjust: Verify paid-up status, permanence, distribution rights, loss-absorption and other Article 28 conditions.
rows.check: Ledger share capital ≠ automatically eligible CET1; match share register and instrument terms.
rows.coordinate_status: Template row verified; technical DPM cell metadata not imported

rows.label: Share premium
rows.definition: Share premium relating to CET1-eligible capital instruments.
rows.link: Additional paid-in capital/share premium under equity, only to the extent related to eligible instruments.
rows.adjust: Exclude share premium associated with instruments that do not meet CET1 conditions.
rows.check: Share premium ledger by instrument series → eligible CET1 premium.
rows.coordinate_status: Template row verified; technical DPM cell metadata not imported

rows.label: Retained earnings
rows.definition: Eligible previous years' retained earnings and eligible interim or year-end profits under CRR eligibility conditions.
rows.link: Retained earnings from equity statement/FINREP can differ from prudential eligible earnings when current profit is not recognised under CRR Art. 26(2).
rows.adjust: Deduct non-eligible profit or foreseeably distributed amounts where required; avoid counting same profit twice.
rows.check: Reconcile prior-year reserves, current eligible profit, expected dividends and supervisory permission.
rows.coordinate_status: Template row verified; technical DPM cell metadata not imported

rows.label: Previous years retained earnings
rows.definition: Prior years' accumulated eligible retained profits, distinct from current interim/year-end profit eligibility.
rows.link: Opening retained earnings balance, adjusted for approved appropriations and scope differences.
rows.adjust: Carry over post-appropriation opening reserve and adjust for any amounts not eligible for CET1.
rows.check: Opening reserve rollforward → prior-year accounting equity and FINREP.
rows.coordinate_status: Template row verified; technical DPM cell metadata not imported

rows.label: Profit or loss eligible
rows.definition: Current/period profit or loss eligible for prudential capital under the CRR framework.
rows.link: Based on IFRS recognised profit, after prudential restrictions. A regulatory inclusion is normally not a new journal entry.
rows.adjust: Positive interim/year-end profit requires qualifying independent verification, deduction of foreseeable charges/dividends and prior competent-authority permission when applicable.
rows.check: IFRS period profit less ineligible amount → prudential eligible profit.
rows.coordinate_status: Template row verified; technical DPM cell metadata not imported

rows.label: (-) Part of interim or year-end profit not eligible
rows.definition: Portion of an accounting-period profit not eligible for recognition as CET1, including relevant expected dividends/charges.
rows.link: A purely prudential deduction in the reconciliation, not necessarily a reduction of recognised IFRS profit.
rows.adjust: Example: IFRS profit 100; foreseeably distributed dividends 30 → only up to 70 considered, subject to verification and supervisory conditions.
rows.check: Accounting profit 100 − ineligible amount 30 = maximum illustrative eligible amount 70.
rows.coordinate_status: Template row verified; technical DPM cell metadata not imported

rows.label: Accumulated other comprehensive income
rows.definition: Eligible accounting OCI accumulated in equity, before applicable prudential filters and after relevant tax effects.
rows.link: FVOCI reserves and other OCI components are sourced from IFRS accounting, then filtered according to the CRR.
rows.adjust: Consider net tax effects, own-credit gains/losses and hedging-related prudential filters.
rows.check: OCI movement/reserves → prudential filters → eligible CET1 component.
rows.coordinate_status: Template row verified; technical DPM cell metadata not imported

rows.label: Other reserves
rows.definition: Other disclosed accounting reserves not already included in retained earnings or accumulated OCI.
rows.link: Equity reserve accounts and equity-change disclosures, classified without double counting.
rows.adjust: Examine legal and accounting classification and ability of reserves to absorb losses.
rows.check: Reserve reclassification does not increase total equity; avoid double counting as retained earnings.
rows.coordinate_status: Template row verified; technical DPM cell metadata not imported

rows.label: Adjustments to CET1 due to prudential filters
rows.definition: Net adjustment required to neutralise specified accounting gains/losses or valuation effects for prudential capital.
rows.link: May derive from OCI or profit recognised under IFRS; the regulatory exclusion normally has no separate IFRS journal.
rows.adjust: Identify hedge/own-credit/prudent valuation effects according to current CRR articles; record signed regulatory adjustment.
rows.check: Trace IFRS carrying value and OCI to signed prudential-filter calculation; avoid treating filter as accounting posting.
rows.coordinate_status: Template row verified; technical DPM cell metadata not imported

rows.label: (-) Goodwill
rows.definition: Goodwill deduction from CET1, including goodwill embedded in relevant significant investments, subject to CRR mechanics.
rows.link: IFRS 3 goodwill from business combinations; supervisory treatment requires consolidation, scope and deductible net amount adjustments.
rows.adjust: Deduct relevant goodwill net of eligible associated deferred tax liabilities and other CRR-specified factors.
rows.check: IFRS goodwill balance + consolidation adjustments − permitted offsets → signed CET1 deduction.
rows.coordinate_status: Template row verified; technical DPM cell metadata not imported

rows.label: (-) Other intangible assets
rows.definition: Applicable CET1 deduction of intangible assets other than goodwill, allowing only CRR-defined exceptions and adjustments.
rows.link: Start from capitalised software, licences and other IAS 38 intangible assets, less relevant accounting amounts; prudential value differs.
rows.adjust: Assess prudently valued software exemption and net deduction of eligible related DTLs; not all intangible balances are fully deducted.
rows.check: Asset subledger → IFRS intangible carrying amount → CRR software rules/DTL adjustments → deduction.
rows.coordinate_status: Template row verified; technical DPM cell metadata not imported

definitions: A double-entry journal posting in an institution's IFRS general ledger (debit and credit), with an accounting date and supported documentation.
Summarises general-ledger closing balances, including equity, OCI, profit and recognised assets/liabilities. Not a COREP submission by itself.
Prudential adjustment or deduction to accounting figures required by the CRR; it may not be an IFRS ledger posting.
Harmonised supervisory financial reporting based broadly on IFRS/GAAP. Useful reconciliation source, but not identical to COREP.
Own funds template (CA1), which reports eligibility-filtered CET1, AT1, T2 and related deductions.
Model-defined reporting fact, linked to a metric and dimensional qualifiers in a specific taxonomy release. An identifier cannot be inferred solely from a COREP row number.
The business qualifier and its permissible value (e.g. reporting entity or consolidation scope); precise EBA IDs require original package import.
